evidence.text: Implemented work.py evaluate(request, evidence, policy): validates missing required request conditions, filters by claim/withdrawn/verification/exact required-condition match, applies supersession only among eligible records, compares canonical JSON values, deep-copies returned value, and emits exact schema fields. Generated report.json from current fixtures. Local baseline and extended checks passed, including input immutability, false=>unsupported, conflicts, canonical object agreement, withdrawal, supersession eligibility, and absent calibration.

Unresolved limits: no repository-provided test suite was present; behavior for malformed records (for example missing/non-string source IDs or non-JSON values such as NaN) is unspecified and intentionally not invented.

Stage 2 findings: work.py evaluate filters by matching claim, withdrawn/verification state, and canonical equality on all policy-required request conditions; reports sorted missing conditions, applies eligible-record supersession, detects canonical JSON agreement/conflict, deep-copies agreed values, and preserves all inputs. report.json was regenerated from current requests/evidence/policy and local baseline plus extended checks passed.

Unresolved limit: no repository test suite was provided. Behavior for malformed/non-JSON inputs (for example non-string source IDs, NaN values, or malformed required_conditions/supersedes fields) is intentionally not specified beyond the task's JSON-shaped contract.

Milestone complete: implemented and verified Stage 2 source comparison in work.py; report.json matches evaluating every current request against current evidence.json and policy.json. Checks covered missing conditions, no evidence, verification/withdrawal filters, canonical agreement and conflict, supersession, Boolean false, exact output fields, and input immutability. Unresolved: malformed or non-JSON-shaped inputs are outside the specified contract; no repository-provided test suite exists.
